title: Polynomial zero count over a finite set
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative integral domain, let $m$ be a natural number, and let $p$ be a nonzero polynomial in $m$ variables over $R$. For a finite nonempty set $S\subseteq R$ with $2\deg(p)\le |S|$, at most half of the functions $f:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\to S$ satisfy $p(f)=0$; equivalently, twice the number of such functions is at most $|S|^m$.
